scope: The source proves a closed projective/fixed-point-blowup criterion with a common translated simplex, ordinary-type limiting solvability, varying nonanalytic isolated poles and smooth degenerate positive-mass residuals. It does not solve general nonclosed Hermitian S08, moving modifications, convergence of solution potentials or rough weighted adjoint products.
